messages:
maria: quick check — streaming client in Rust started getting 401s after a deploy. Only happened for some users. Using API_KEY in env and building Basic header like `Authorization: Basic {base64(api_key + ':')}`. Any quick sanity checks?

kevin: Did you verify no trailing newline? `echo $REDWOOD_API_KEY | hexdump -C` or `printf '%s' "$REDWOOD_API_KEY" | xxd -p` — echo adds newline by default.

sam: also make sure you're not adding extra colon. For basic auth with apikey as username, the header is base64("apikey:") not base64(":apikey") :)

maria: here's what I do in code:
```
rust
let header = format!("Basic {}", base64::encode(format!("{}:", api_key)));
```
still 401 for some envs.

kevin: run this locally in the container where it fails: `python -c "import os,sys;print(repr(os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY')))"` shows '\x00abc...'? If you see `\n` or `\r` there you know.

maria: I ran `od -An -t x1 <<< "$REDWOOD_API_KEY"` and saw `0a` at end. ugh :facepalm:

sam: fix with `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(tr -d '\r\n' < <(printf '%s' "$REDWOOD_API_KEY"))` or better write to file without newline.

olivia: can we add a tiny devex doc section + CI check that runs `printf '%s' "$API_KEY" | xxd -p | grep -E '0d|0a|00'` and fail? saves time.

dev-bot: reminder: deploy lint found `env-sample` missing note about no-newline in README — https://git.internal/.. (automated)

maria: thanks all — will patch image, add check, and ping @eng-runtime for release window. Will follow up in PR.

kevin: also FYI some libraries for windows add `\r` when copying from Notepad; add a note for Windows users.

sam: :thumbsup:
